tutorial: Basic_Part_Design_Tutorial_019.md (FreeCAD wiki: Basic Part Design Tutorial 019), built on the body's planes with the tutorial's dimensions; then extra calls for the tools the tutorial does not use.
reference: github.com/FreeCAD/Examples: Basic_Part_Design_Tutorial_Example_Files/Basic_Part_Design_Tutorial.FCStd (on the Mac: the reference copy: Basic_Part_Design_Tutorial.FCStd)
referenceNotes: The answer key is the OLD tutorial's file (saved by FreeCAD 0.16, no Body: Pad, Pocket, Mirrored, Pad001, Mirrored001, Pad002, Pocket001 at the document's top level). It is the same part, built another way and placed differently: its profile is centred (y, z from -13 to 13), the 019 tutorial's sits at y -26..0, z 0..26. Compare by volume and box size, or after moving by [0, -13, 13].

The key holds one feature the tutorials' text does not: Pad002, a 1 mm pad of the hole's rectangle on the slanted face, which Pocket001 (through all, from the back) does not fully remove. By my arithmetic that leaves a sliver of about 6.9 mm³ above the hole's upper edge, so the key's volume should read about 18514.7, not 18507.86. I could not measure the key here (no CAD kernel): measure it on the Mac before using it as an exact answer.

Dimensions taken from the tutorial text (53, 26, 5, 11 x 5, 7, 16.7, 17, 7, pocket 8.5 + 8.5) and, where the text points at figures only, from the key's sketches (the profile's 26 x 26 with a 5 mm top; the hole 7 mm up the slanted face).

tutorialPart.derivation: analytic, from the tutorial's dimensions: trapezoid profile 403 mm² x 53; corner cuts 11 mm of the top 5 mm of the profile; side blocks 7 x 26 x 16.7 less what the profile already fills; centre hole 17 mm wide between the heights 7·sinθ and 24·sinθ (θ the slanted face's angle, tanθ = 26/21)

otherBodies.Plate: 12000 ± 131.23 (draft) - 502.65 (four bores), doubled by the whole-body mirror, less the M6 holes

expected.dof: not applicable here: the sketches are drawn by coordinates, unconstrained on purpose (the Sketcher model covers constraints); pd_ answers carry sketchDof when a sketch has freedom left

notCovered: pd_pad / pd_pocket types up_to_face, up_to_first, up_to_last and taper: the tutorial uses lengths and through_all only; no expected numbers derived. Try pd_pad { body: Hist, sketch on XY, type up_to_face, upToFace: { at: [-70, 25, 5], normal: [0, 0, 1] } } by hand.
pd_hole countersink / counterdrill, modelThread: true (slow), clearance holes (threaded: false, fit): one threaded counterbored hole only.
pd_draft with a face as the neutral plane, pd_mirrored across a face or a datum plane: covered by tests/test_feature.py (test_9a) rather than here.
pd_multitransform mirror, polar and scale steps: only two linear steps.
pd_gear kind sprocket and internal: true: no expected numbers; FreeCAD's sprocket module could not be exercised here.
pd_loft closed and subtractive; pd_pipe subtractive, Mode and Transition (feature_edit).
pd_boolean fuse and common; pd_binder frozen and whole-shape; pd_primitive sphere, cone, ellipsoid, torus, prism, wedge.
